description: An oscillator and distortion built on the Rossler attractor, a three dimensional chaotic system

params.text: Sets the first coefficient of the attractor, 0 to 1; the classic shape is at 0.2
Sets the second coefficient of the attractor, 0 to 1; the classic shape is at 0.2
Sets the third coefficient of the attractor, 0 to 30; the classic shape is at 5.7, and raising it folds the orbit into more loops
Sets how hard the external input pushes the system, 0 to 10
Crossfades the output from the system's own signal at 0 to the external input at 1

inputs.text: Sets how fast the system runs, a volt per octave about C4
The signal pushed into the system, and the one the mix knob fades towards

outputs.text: Carries the system's first coordinate, divided by three, mixed with the external input by the mix knob

notes: the system runs whether or not anything is patched, so the output puts out a chaotic waveform on its own; the external input bends the orbit rather than being filtered by it
the y and z coordinates of the attractor are computed but the maker commented out their output jacks, so only x can be heard
menu: Updated processing behavior — uses the corrected two-step integration; unticked, the module reverts to an earlier version that used the second slope estimate twice and sounds different
